before_times: what the client wants to work on, in their own words (a habit, sleep, stress, confidence)
in the studio, by video, or at a home or office
a practitioner by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
for a teen (16 or 17): the age; a parent or guardian books
after_time: at a home or office: parking, the room, and a quiet space with a chair and a door that closes
anything the client would like the practitioner to know before the first session, in their own words
secure_page_only: 18 or older, or 16 or 17 with a parent or guardian's consent on the page
the intake form: current goals, epilepsy, a recent head injury, a psychosis diagnosis, medicines, alcohol or drugs, and any care from a doctor or counselor
for a teen: the parent's consent, and that the parent waits on site
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult, for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a 16 or 17 year old, who waits on site; no one under 16 (the example's setting)

stop.words: thoughts of harming yourself or someone else, or a crisis right now
stop.say: Please call or text 988 now, or call 911 if you're in danger. A session can't help with a crisis, so nothing is booked.

stop.words: a seizure, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing, or hearing voices that tell someone to act
stop.say: This could be an emergency. Call 911 now. A session can wait.

stop.words: epilepsy, a recent head injury, or a psychosis diagnosis
stop.say: Please check with your doctor first. Hypnotherapy waits until a doctor says it's OK, in writing, on this page.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK, in writing

go_on.words: a headache or a stiff neck
go_on.what: the practitioner moves to a quieter chair or a shorter session; the session goes on
the visit moves with no fee

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm → call 911 or 988, and no booking

steps.name: Intake form
steps.when: on the secure page before the first session (due when booking, inside the saved 10 minutes); a returning client confirms or updates it by the day before
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until the client's health or goals change
steps.result: most answers change nothing; a flag (epilepsy, a head injury, a psychosis diagnosis, a doctor's care) goes to the practitioner to read before the booking is kept

steps.name: Practitioner's read of a flag
steps.when: before the booking is written, in the practitioner's text hours; no answer in 1 hour: Sam reads it
steps.result: OK as booked; OK with a note (a shorter session, no eye closing); a doctor's OK in writing first; or no, with the reason kept private

steps.name: A teen's consent
steps.when: on the secure page, from the parent or guardian who books
steps.result: the parent shows an ID at check-in and waits on site

first_steps_and_forms.prep: come 5 minutes early; eat lightly; tell the studio on the secure page about any change in health or medicines; at home or in an office: a quiet room with a chair and a door that closes

staff.skills: hypnotherapy for habits, sleep, stress and confidence; relaxation and take-home audio; only practitioners with the training a booking names are offered
staff.licenses_or_certificates: no state license for hypnotherapy in most places; a certificate or membership is each practitioner's own word, shown only if they choose; never checked by Rosie (D96)
staff.supervision: a student works only with a named practitioner in the room, where the business sets it (none in the example)
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs same-day sessions and new clients at the studio; he can set every home or office visit to ask him first; a health flag goes to the booked practitioner, then to Sam after 1 hour
staff.stand_in: a stand-in must fit what the client asked (a woman, if asked) and the training booked, and gets the intake and notes

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult, for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a 16 or 17 year old, who waits on site; no one under 16 (the example's setting)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen's booking texts go only to the parent or guardian; Rosie never texts the teen
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent or guardian's written consent on the secure page for a 16 or 17 year old, and a parent waiting on site

visit.check_in: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; at a home or office: the code at the door, from the client who booked; by video: the link on the secure page
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the practitioner; the practitioner's notes (goals, what was worked on) go in the client's private record
visit.changes_at_visit: a take-home audio or a longer session is priced and OK'd before it's done
visit.before_work: the practitioner goes over the intake and what the client wants with the client before starting; the client can stop at any time, and can open their eyes, speak or leave the room

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none checked by Rosie: hypnotherapy has no state license in most places; a certificate or membership is the practitioner's own word, optional, and never checked (D96)
license.who: the business, for any registration or membership it chooses to show; each practitioner's certificate is their own word
license.ask: optional: a registration number or a certificate the business wants shown; nothing is asked of each practitioner
license.insurance: professional liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; shown only if the business chooses
license.background: any background check is the business's own policy, not checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: the reason for a visit, goals, health answers, medicines, a doctor's note and the practitioner's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
